name: zcode-git-worktrees
description: Git worktree support for ZCode — parallel, isolated work with safety guarantees.

plugins.name: git-worktrees
plugins.description: Every thread gets its own worktree — automatically. Start a thread in any repo and it instantly gets an isolated git checkout: parallel tasks without stashing, branch juggling, or overwriting each other. Uncommitted work is snapshotted before anything is removed, background agents run tasks inside their own worktrees, and PRs check out with one command.
examplePrompts: Create a worktree for this refactor and run it in a background agent
Check out PR 1234 into a worktree for review
